page.overview:
Who is Rudibert Bolger?

Rudibert Bolger was a hobbit of the Shire.

Rudibert was born in TA 2860 (SR 1260), the second son of Adalgar Bolger and his unnamed wife. He married Amethyst Hornblower and had one child, a son named Adalbert Bolger.
